name: update
description:
Send all sections to preserve grouping, or rows when exactly one section exists. Each row has three text cells (≤4,000 characters), 1–100 sections with unique IDs (1–64 alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen), a nonempty title ≤200 characters and description ≤4,000 characters. The default section must remain; ≤10,000 rows total. revision must equal the current revision. The bundled official MISP attribute catalog is selectable/storable; export capability/help is supplied per type. Known compatibility aliases normalize on save; exact MISP canonical names take precedence. text/comment/other retain literal Unicode/whitespace and export as non-detection x-misp-attribute objects; Valid scalar attributes without native mappings use the official MISP-compatible contextual representation, with informational stix.notices. Missing attachment/sample bytes and invalid values retain saved drafts with explicit stix.issues. Legacy android-package aliases normalize to mobile-application-id while retaining identity and original_type provenance. Unknown/ambiguous types and invalid values remain saved as drafts with stix.issues; CSV is refreshed and stale STIX removed. Fully exportable tables generate iocs/indicators.stix.json with refanged native patterns and faithful contextual objects; any unsupported row withholds the entire STIX output. Preserve optional row_meta (including explicit boolean to_ids detection intent) and stix_meta when editing to retain IDs/timestamps/intent; do not generate them yourself. Unchanged saves do not advance revision. The authenticated web Indicators workspace provides CSV/STIX import previews and a read-only download; equivalent versioned preview/import/STIX download endpoints are also available to SDK clients.

Required role permission: indicators:write.

Content edits require Malware Analysis or Packaging & Delivery stage and an active owner when ownership is mandatory.
